title: End-to-end walkthrough call (placeholder)
detail: Call with Team A, Team C and Finance, speakers pseudonymised

records.text: Requesters send the request form by email to Team A.
Team A logs every request in the tracker and checks it is complete.
If anything is missing the request goes back to the requester.
Urgent requests skip the queue and Team B looks at them the same day.
Finance reserves the budget as soon as the category is set.
Team C asks suppliers for quotes, usually three.
We compare the quotes by hand and pick the cheapest suitable one.
Team B puts the request, the quotes and the budget code into one approval pack.
Anything over 10,000 needs a finance sign-off after the approver signs.
If the approver has comments, the pack goes back to Team B.
Once the order is raised, Finance commits the budget.
Suppliers confirm the order in the supplier portal, but some never do.
Chasing suppliers that have not confirmed takes most of a day each week.
Invoices are matched to the order and the delivery before we pay.
When the goods arrive the request is closed in the tracker.
We would like AI to read the request form and log it for us.
If we could automate the chasing, that would save Team C a lot of time.
An AI draft of the approval pack would help Team B too.
We are not sure what happens to the reserved budget when a request is rejected.
Finance pays suppliers on the next payment run.
We only ask approved suppliers for quotes, so we check the supplier in the portal first.
Once Team B has reviewed a request, Team A marks it as reviewed in the tracker.
The records team keeps a copy of every purchase order.
When an invoice does not match, Team C queries it with the supplier and we match it again.
When the goods arrive the requester rates the supplier on the request form.
